card: This PR adds assert_true() and assert_false() helper functions to test_framework/util.py and migrates boolean literal comparisons from assert_equal across 95 functional test files via a scripted diff. It solves the visual clutter and scanning overhead of trailing boolean arguments in long test expressions while preserving strict boolean checks that standard Python assert does not provide. The author notes this reduces cognitive overhead and aligns with patterns in standard testing frameworks. The change is an internal test framework refactor with no dependencies.
changed_since_previous: Rebased with no functional changes to the approach or scope.
evidence: PR description: "The main point of this change is that `assert_true()`/`assert_false()` reduce cognitive tokens when scanning the code (equals to *what*...?). (As a consequence, `assert_true()`/`assert_false()` are also common in other test frameworks)."

PR description: "`assert_true([expression])` is different from plain `assert [expression]` in that `assert` is truthy while `assert_true` requires boolean `True`. (`assert` can also be deactivated when executing Python code in optimized mode...)"
problem: Tests asserting boolean values previously used `assert_equal(expr, True)` or `assert_equal(expr, False)`, which requires scanning past long expressions to see what condition is being tested against. Built-in Python `assert expr` cannot be used as an alternative because it checks loose truthiness rather than boolean identity and can be bypassed under optimized execution modes.

risk.why: Touches only functional test files and test framework utilities without affecting node validation or consensus code.

scope_notes: Contains a scripted-diff commit touching 95 test files, preceded by commits that add helper functions and fix up imports.
summary: Introduces `assert_true()` and `assert_false()` helpers to the functional test framework in `test/functional/test_framework/util.py` to enforce strict boolean equality. Uses a scripted diff to convert existing calls of `assert_equal(..., True)` and `assert_equal(..., False)` across 95 functional test files to the new assertions, followed by cleanup of unused imports.
